hook_line: RAMAYANA ADVANCE BOOKING CROSSES RS 100 CRORE WORLDWIDE AHEAD OF RELEASE

hook_stat.sub: Reported worldwide pre-sales two days before the November 5 release

stats.label: Overseas advance bookings by Tuesday morning

diaspora_bullets: More than $1.5 million from US paid previews scheduled for November 4
North America has emerged as an important contributor
news_summary: Ramayana has crossed Rs 100 crore in worldwide advance bookings, with reported pre-sales of about Rs 105 crore two days before the November 5 release.
payoff: The film opens in cinemas on November 5, 2026.
